summary: This clinical trial will study how well once-weekly Tirzepatide works alongside standard diabetes drugs in obese patients with Type 2 diabetes. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and aims to enroll 52 participants. Akhtar Saeed Medical and Dental College is sponsoring this research, which carries No phase. Participants will be compared to a control group receiving only standard oral antidiabetic drugs.

facts.sponsor: Akhtar Saeed Medical and Dental College
